content.what_it_is: MATLAB function generating a directional TMA-type wave spectrum with deliberately coherent components for the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence case (WKDATA2D wavemaker input generator). Signature: [freq_out,Spectrum_Energy,Hmo_each,reps,AG] = Coherence_Spectrum(idx_theta,freq_in,freq_resolution,theta,host_freqs_idx) (L1-L2). It loads shared parameters from inputs.mat (L5). Coherent-frequency assignment (L11-L48): host frequencies are those at mean direction (freq_in(host_freqs_idx), L11); the remaining pool (L14-L15) donates Num_Coherent = round(Coherent_Percentage/100*mcomponent) components (L17); a while loop (L27-L46) randomly picks a guest frequency (ceil(rand*mfreq_temp), L30), removes it from the pool (L33), finds the nearest host frequency above it (freq_diff with negatives set inf, then min; L35-L37), replaces the guest frequency by the host frequency in freq_temp (L40), and updates the repetition counts reps until the coherent count reaches the target (L42-L45). Spectrum (L51-L78): per component, TMA depth factor phi from omiga_spec=2*pi*f*sqrt(depth/g) with the Kitaigorodskii three-branch form (L53-L59), JONSWAP sigma 0.09/0.07 above/below fp (L60-L64), Etma = g^2 f^-5 (2pi)^-4 phi exp(-5/4 (f/fp)^-4) gamma^exp(...) (L66-L67), bin energy and total (L68-L69); directional weight AG(kf) as a truncated wrapped-normal cosine series with N_spec=20/sigma_theta terms around theta_mean (L72-L77). Calibration (L80-L85): alpha_spec=Hmo^2/16/Energy_total, correction_coeff normalizes sum(AG.*EnergyBin), Hmo_each=4*sqrt(alpha_spec*EnergyBin.*AG), and Spectrum_Energy=(Hmo_each/4).^2/freq_resolution/pi. Hmo_output (L87) recomputes the total for checking; freq_out=freq_coherent (L89).
entities: Coherence_Spectrum — function(idx_theta, freq_in, freq_resolution, theta, host_freqs_idx) returning [freq_out, Spectrum_Energy, Hmo_each, reps, AG] (L1-L2)
Num_Coherent — target number of coherent components (L17)
reps — repetition count per frequency (L21, L42-L43)
host_idx_whole — host index in the full list (L39)
omiga_spec — nondimensional frequency for TMA phi (L53)
Etma — TMA spectral density per component (L66)
N_spec — number of wrapped-normal series terms (L72)
AG — directional weight per component (L73-L77, L83)
alpha_spec — energy scaling to match input Hmo (L80)
Hmo_output — reconstructed total Hmo for checking (L87)

variables loaded from inputs.mat: Coherent_Percentage (L17), mcomponent (L17), mfreq (L21, L52), depth (L53), g (L53, L66, L80... via expressions), fp (L60, L66), gamma_spec (L67), sigma_theta (L72, L75), theta_mean (L76), Hmo (L80)

io.name: inputs.mat (Coherent_Percentage, mcomponent, mfreq, depth, g, fp, gamma_spec, sigma_theta, theta_mean, Hmo)

unresolved: All spectral parameters come from load inputs.mat (L5) — Coherent_Percentage, mcomponent, mfreq, depth, g, fp, gamma_spec, sigma_theta, theta_mean, Hmo are never defined in this file, so the function's behavior is opaque without that mat-file (produced by a sibling script not in this file).
The input arguments idx_theta and freq_in vs the loaded mfreq/mcomponent overlap in role; idx_theta is never used in the function body.

Host selection maps each guest to the nearest host frequency ABOVE it (negative differences set to inf, L35-L37); if a guest exceeds all hosts, min of all-inf gives index 1 — behavior in that edge case is questionable and unguarded.

reps bookkeeping (L42-L43) assigns the host's count to every component sharing that frequency; whether Num_Coherent counts components or frequencies is ambiguous (coherent_idx counts entries with reps>1, L44-L45), so the loop may overshoot the requested percentage.
The while loop can exhaust freqs_pool before reaching Num_Coherent if the count logic stalls; no guard exists (L27-L46).
The comment '% 79.6287' (L70) is an unexplained magic number left in the code.
Hmo_output (L87) is computed as a check but never compared or returned.
The wrapped-normal series truncation N_spec=20/sigma_theta (L72) is not an integer in general; MATLAB's colon operator truncates implicitly.
